name: Winston Churchill
summary: Churchill defended parliamentary government, private enterprise and constitutional monarchy while supporting social insurance and a national health service. He favoured strong Western defence and European cooperation, and his imperial outlook included opposition to much colonial independence and hierarchical views of peoples.
